lines.text: We'll take to the high seas, I'm sure of it!
The Admire is invincible. I just have to prove it.
This is just a prop sword, so don't be scared.
You need to take better care of yourself.
Will you join us at the next fundraiser?
When we finally take to the high seas, I hope you'll be there with me.
What are you doing? If you have nothing better to do, I'm leaving.
You zoned out for a while back there. Are you all right? If you're feeling under the weather, just let me know.
The observatory... I'm sure Anchor will love it here.
This place is so well-maintained. I wonder where they're getting their money from?
It's been ages since I went for a swim... O-oh, never mind...
I look forward to the day I go on a voyage with you.
Another step closer to my dream.
If I convert this to credits... O-oh, never mind... Thanks.
I will never let you down.
You can put donations over there. Wait, it's a gift? Oh... um... S-sorry.
You shouldn't spend so much on me... but thanks, anyways.
Thanks, but I feel bad accepting it.
I'm sorry, but I'm not blushing right now, am I?
Can I ask you a question? Do you... um... get around a lot?
These feelings weren't mentioned in the textbook...
Finally, it's time we can show everyone what we're capable of!
Please make your orders clear and concise.
All right, moving in.
Engaging with the enemy.
If we can't clinch the victory...
You can always count on quality training.
Time to show them what we're made of.
Reloading. Cover me.
We can do it faster.
All right, let's keep going.
Admire, stand by.
Full speed ahead! Aegis cannon, fire!
All gunports open! Fire!
Next!
Enemy down!
Direct hit!
Urgh!
Ow!
This is nothing...!
That's it... I'll leave the rest to you.
With this, we're one step closer to our dream.

An emergency? I'll get changed into my uniform and head out right away! 
... What? That's not necessary?

I'm taking a steam bath.
I'm almost done, so I'll get back to the mission soon.

I'm sure the bathroom is a bit warm due to all the steam.
Sorry, I'll get ready as quickly as I can and go out.

It's strange... I feel like I'm becoming more conscious of your gaze...
Can I get changed and come back?

It makes me feel a bit self-conscious with you watching...
Er, could you look away for a moment?

Getting a good steam is quite therapeutic.
You should give it a try sometime, Subordinate.
If you're busy, I can go get some things prepared.

If you have something urgent to take care of, go ahead.
I'll be soaking my feet in the meantime.

Do you think we could fill the Outpost's pool with warm water?
I'd love for everyone to experience what it's like to have a nice, hot soak.

Now that I think about it, don't you have a bathtub in your room?
I think it'd be great for you to have a steam sometime.

What's my favorite bath toy? 
Not sure... Although I think I would like having a miniature of the Admire.

Being in warm water feels much better than I thought. 
Would you like to try it for yourself later?
Is this thanks to all those steam treatments...?
Thanks for giving me time to regroup.
I couldn't have done this without your support. I'll repay you with stellar results.
I... I'm not really sure how I should express my gratitude. Thank you so much.
You know what I like better than I do.
Thanks to you, I can feel this warmth filling up my heart.

Lately, my mind goes a bit fuzzy whenever I see you.
Could it be because I stayed in the bath for too long?

I'd love for us to be alone together forever,
even though I know that's impossible.
This feeling of warmth that you give me is something I'll cherish forever.
Right now? Er... Okay, no problem.
Standing by.
Yes, understood.
Everyone, prepare for battle!
Don't worry about me. My body is in perfect condition.
I'm going to finish this quickly and get back to the warm water.
Time to show what steam treatments can do.
Dang it, my hands are too slippery.
Careful now... Let's go again.
Back to it.
I'm ready.
Will you join me, Subordinate?
The time has come! Let's give it our all!
Resolved!
Gotta go faster!
There's no escape!
Ugh!
Gah!
Argh!
I... I'm sorry for failing you, Subordinate.
Whew... I'm glad that's all resolved, but now I need to wash up again.
